entries.title: PHI request prohibition
entries.summary: AtliQ is prohibited from requesting or receiving Protected Health Information under this Agreement, which requires a separate Business Associate Agreement prior to any such disclosure.
entries.quote: Protected Health Information, as defined at 45 C.F.R. § 160.103, is excluded from this Agreement and shall be disclosed only after execution of a Business Associate Agreement between the Parties. Harrington shall not disclose, and AtliQ shall not request, Protected Health Information under this Agreement.

services: enterprise clinical and operational analytics platform

relatedClauses.quote: The Parties wish to evaluate a potential engagement under which AtliQ would design and implement an enterprise clinical and operational analytics platform for Harrington (the "Purpose")

entries.endRule: Two years from the Effective Date, ending on 2028-08-20.
entries.notes: Limits information transfer to non-PHI data until a separate BAA is fully executed.
